subject.why: The heart-shaped hedge archway entrance with red roses is clearly depicted and recognisable.

category.why: The setting is not limited to a simple strip at the bottom; continuous hedge walls fill the sides and interior view, replacing the open sky gradient and horizon.

clean.why: No text, UI, watermarks, or characters are present.

framing.why: The hedges bleed off both the left and right edges with no side margins, crowding the frame.

colour.why: Colours are bright, saturated, and juicy with good contrast between the red roses, green foliage, and blue sky.

detail.why: The leaves and roses are rendered as smooth, chunky volumes without noisy micro-details.

style.why: Matches the reference style with soft volumetric shapes, clean lighting, and a satin sheen.

fix: Pull the camera back to give the hedge arch clear margins on the left and right, and remove the flanking side walls so only a clean strip of ground sits at the bottom beneath an open sky.
